WITH hits AS (
  SELECT
    s.idsubfuncao,
    s.codigosubfuncao,
    s.descricaosubfuncao,
    f.codigofuncao,
    f.descricaofuncao,
    CASE
      WHEN ltrim(s.codigo_digits, '0') = $1 THEN 0
      WHEN ltrim(f.codigo_digits, '0') = $1 THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END AS match_case
  FROM subfuncao s
  JOIN funcao f ON f.idfuncao = s.funcao_idfuncao
  WHERE ltrim(s.codigo_digits, '0') LIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
     OR ltrim(f.codigo_digits, '0') LIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
)
SELECT
  h.codigosubfuncao,
  h.descricaosubfuncao,
  h.codigofuncao,
  h.descricaofuncao,
  count(h.idsubfuncao) OVER () AS total,
  $3::text AS termo
FROM (SELECT 1) AS one
LEFT JOIN hits h ON true
ORDER BY h.match_case, h.codigosubfuncao, h.descricaosubfuncao
LIMIT $2

WITH hits AS (
  SELECT
    s.idsubfuncao,
    s.codigosubfuncao,
    s.descricaosubfuncao,
    f.codigofuncao,
    f.descricaofuncao,
    GREATEST(
      CASE WHEN strpos(unaccent(lower(s.descricaosubfuncao)), unaccent(lower($1))) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END,
      CASE WHEN strpos(unaccent(lower(f.descricaofuncao)), unaccent(lower($1))) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END,
      similarity(unaccent(lower(s.descricaosubfuncao)), unaccent(lower($1))),
      similarity(unaccent(lower(f.descricaofuncao)), unaccent(lower($1)))
    ) AS score
  FROM subfuncao s
  JOIN funcao f ON f.idfuncao = s.funcao_idfuncao
  WHERE nullif(unaccent(lower($1)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND GREATEST(
      CASE WHEN strpos(unaccent(lower(s.descricaosubfuncao)), unaccent(lower($1))) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END,
      CASE WHEN strpos(unaccent(lower(f.descricaofuncao)), unaccent(lower($1))) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END,
      similarity(unaccent(lower(s.descricaosubfuncao)), unaccent(lower($1))),
      similarity(unaccent(lower(f.descricaofuncao)), unaccent(lower($1)))
    ) >= $2
)
SELECT
  h.codigosubfuncao,
  h.descricaosubfuncao,
  h.codigofuncao,
  h.descricaofuncao,
  h.score,
  count(h.idsubfuncao) OVER () AS total,
  $1::text AS termo
FROM (SELECT 1) AS one
LEFT JOIN hits h ON true
ORDER BY h.score DESC NULLS LAST, h.codigosubfuncao, h.descricaosubfuncao
LIMIT $3
